data.notes: The review gets the header right and challenges the rep's 'timing' framing with the payback request made a month before the freeze. Its decider, competitor, message and proof actions match the key: reach the CFO with the customer's own number, build a cost-of-doing-nothing talk track, drop the revenue framing, and line up a staged-migration reference. It misses the trigger insight that there was no compelling event, which left the deal exposed to any freeze, and it never names Value proof outright. Two pairs of findings overlap: words and message both say to replace revenue language with roadmap language, and decider and competitor both say to build a finance-facing number.
